How TicWatch Connector uses health data

Heart-rate samples measured by your TicWatch are written to Health Connect, and a resting heart rate is derived from them on this phone. The app only writes data; it does not read your Health Connect records or share them with third parties.

While enabled, any client on your network that knows the address and token can call the agent\'s tools. Use only on a trusted network and keep the token private. The agent turns itself off after 30 minutes without requests.
Give the external model the address as an MCP server URL (Streamable HTTP) and the token as a Bearer header. From a PC over USB: adb forward tcp:%1$d tcp:%1$d, then use http://localhost:%1$d%2$s.
